nom: Paula's Choice Water Infusing Electrolyte Moisturizer

avis.texte: A little about my skin type... sensitive and breakout prone when it comes to using moisturizers, hair products, and any type of body lotions that somehow make its way to my face. I actually tried this a year ago when my face was dehydrated and breaking out in the winter. When I first put it on my face it was like instant relief ... and I have been using it since. I use it more sparingly in the summer and mix it with a vitamin c sunscreen and a bb cream but this time of year I use it with full force. I only wish they made one for the body (in winter months Cerave SA is my go to but I have to make sure it doesn't get on my face). The only negative thing is the amount you get for the price. I would love a bigger bottle.

I recently got this product, so I'm not 100% certain how good the long term effects will be, BUT: - The moisturizer works pretty well, spreads easily and you need a tiny amount to cover the entire face - The smell is why I gave it 3 stars, it smells like cheap multi-vitamins. It's so unappealing that I will still use the product to not waste money, but will not purchase again.

avis.titre: Love the Product, Not the Price
avis.texte: This moisturizer is a fantastic find for combination skin. The Water-Infusing Electrolyte formula provides deep hydration without triggering acne. Its fragrance-free formulation is perfect for sensitive skin. My only real criticism is that it's a shame Paula's Choice products rarely seem to have promotions or sales on Amazon.
This is my favorite day and night cream.y sensitive skin loves it. It locks in the moisture and the skin feels very soft. Its texture is lightweight. It is unscented which is very important to me.

I had been looking for a water-based moisturizer for my super dry skin and this isn't it. It goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly, but it didn't provide lasting hydration. If you have super dry skin like me (think constant struggling with skin flaking if not hydrated enough and needing thicker/denser cream moisturizers), this can be used maybe as a pre-moisturizer, but another moisturizer would be required/applied after this to get you through your day/night without drying out. Again, for the dryness of my skin and the cost of this product, it doesn't make sense to incorporate into my regimen and I will not buy again. Additionally, there was a bit of a scent that was a little off-putting. It's not so off-putting that I wouldn't use it if it had provided the hydration I needed, but it was noticeable.

My skin has never been dry using this product. I sweat a lot and this holds up fairly well. You don't need much to cover the whole face and there is no weird smell. Have oily skin and this works well for me. Repurchasing

This is the only product I love from Paula's Choice. It has improved the appearance of my skin. For the people who say it dried them out are not following it with an occlusive. There are no occlusive ingredients in this and it will dry you out if you don't lock it in.
THE BEST MOISTURIZER for sensitive skin. Very light weight, completely scentless, lasts overnight. Only thing I wish is that it came in a larger amount but it’s good.
I like the consistency of this product how ever every time I use it, it would give me a horrible pimple or just make my skin red. I really wanted to love this product
